subject: Using line transect sampling for plant densities

messages.author: 3d74d2f1c48b0b45
messages.subject: Re: Using line transect sampling for plant densities
parts:
Katrina,

We've used variable-width line transect methods to estimate plant
densities... Basically, we randomly pick a compass bearing and wander in
that direction, then measure distances to the plants as they are
encountered with a range finder. Any particular question or concerns?

Best,
Bob Steidl

> >
> >Katrina Daish
